market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure in 1–3 month window. Oil near US$100, RBA recession pivot, and weak business conditions cap upside. Gold and energy names outperform; banks and iron ore lag. Volatility elevated on Hormuz headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. If RBA cuts 50–75bps, rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, construction) recover. Iron ore remains structurally challenged. Gold discovery cycle in WA supports junior miners. Energy transition vs data centre demand creates long-term investment themes. China decoupling is a persistent headwind.
